capabilities: Highlight or underline text selections with four colors
Attach footnote thoughts to annotated passages
Browse, search, filter, and edit the current note's annotations in a sidebar
Export excerpts with source links and heading paths to Markdown files
Switch highlights to grayscale line patterns for e-ink displays
extras: Ships with a separate companion Inkstone theme (light only) that works without the plugin; native mobile apps and physical e-ink devices are untested, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to highlight or underline text while reading and attach thoughts to those passages as navigable footnotes.
summary: Reading annotation plugin that adds underlines, four highlight colors, footnote-based thoughts, an annotation sidebar, and Markdown excerpt export.
